description:
Prince Myung Yiyoon of Hwan, burdened by a perilous royal lineage and a secret healing ability, encounters Emperor Ki Woohee in the palace gardens. Despite Woohee's apparent interest and courtship, Yiyoon must navigate the dangers of trusting a powerful figure with an ulterior motive. Will Yiyoon be able to discover the emperor’s true intentions, resisting the seductive trap he has set just for him?

**Original Novel:**  
[RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/1962134397), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/mh1539), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/detail.asp?series_num=918000469)
